supplements.title: Protective Role of Apigenin-PEGylated Chitosan Nanoparticles Against Pesticide Deltamethrin-Induced Liver Injury via Antioxidant Activation, NF-κB Inhibition, and Bcl-2/Bax/Caspase-3 Signaling Modulation.
supplements.summary: Apigenin-loaded nanoparticles effectively protect rat livers from pesticide damage by boosting antioxidants and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: 12‑weeks fisetin supplementation and interval resistance with aerobic training: changes in Maresin‑1 and inflammatory markers in men with obesity: a randomized controlled trial.
supplements.summary: Fisetin supplements combined with exercise training increased inflammation-resolving molecules and improved metabolic health in obese men.

supplements.title: Effects of Exercise on Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise may help reduce memory and attention problems that cancer survivors experience after treatment.

supplements.title: Integrative Database-Driven In Silico and In Vitro Study of Anemarrhena asphodeloides Bunge Highlighting Hippeastrine as a Regulator of the HSP90/PI3K/Akt/mTOR Axis in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Hippeastrine, a compound from a plant extract, kills oral cancer cells by blocking a key growth pathway called HSP90/PI3K/Akt/mTOR.

supplements.title: Advances in extraction, purification, and pharmacological mechanisms of calycosin: a comprehensive review.
supplements.summary: Calycosin from Astragalus shows promise against cancer and inflammation through multiple cellular pathways with low toxicity.

supplements.title: Resveratrol's hepatic symphony: conducting a multi-stage intervention in liver cancer's progression.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol, a natural plant compound, shows promise fighting liver cancer by blocking multiple disease stages from inflammation to tumor growth.

supplements.title: Formula Probiotic Fermentation After Enzymatic Pretreatment Enhances Immunomodulatory Effects of Edible Seaweed Sargassum fusiforme via Gut Microbial Regulation.
supplements.summary: Fermented seaweed polysaccharides boost immune function by increasing beneficial gut bacteria and their protective metabolites.

supplements.title: Zerumbone Induces Apoptosis and Inhibits Migration of A2058 Melanoma stem-like Cells by Producing Reactive Oxygen Species, Causing G2/M Cell Cycle Arrest, and Controlling the Expression of Genes Linked to Metastasis.
supplements.summary: Zerumbone kills melanoma cancer cells by triggering cell death, stopping cell division, and reducing cancer spread through reactive oxygen species production.

supplements.title: Bio-inspired self-assembly of omega-3 fatty acids and peptides for responsive drug delivery.
supplements.summary: Omega-3 fatty acid nanoparticles deliver cancer drugs on-demand when they encounter tumor-specific enzymes, reducing toxicity to healthy cells.

supplements.title: Low-dose Andrographolide Synergizes With Cytarabine or Vincristine in Plasma Cell Neoplasm Cell Lines.
supplements.summary: Low-dose andrographolide boosts the cancer-killing effects of two standard drugs in plasma cell neoplasm cells.

supplements.title: Scutellarein Induces Apoptosis in SCC-25 Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma Cells Through Suppression of the PI3K/Akt Pathway.
supplements.summary: Scutellarein, a natural compound, kills oral cancer cells by blocking a protein pathway that normally helps tumors survive.

supplements.title: Unveiling the Anti-tumor Actions and Therapeutic Potential of Calcitriol in Colorectal Cancer.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D (calcitriol) reduces colorectal cancer growth by suppressing tumor cells and dampening pro-inflammatory immune responses, though optimal dosing remains unclear.

supplements.title: Ginsenoside Rh4 Induces Apoptosis Through ROS-Mediated Fas Signaling in Human Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma NPC/HK1 Cells.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rh4, a ginseng compound, kills nasopharyngeal cancer cells by triggering a natural cell death pathway.

supplements.title: Enzalutamide Enhanced Honokiol-induced Apoptotic Insults to Drug-resistant Glioblastoma Cells via an Intrinsic Bak-mitochondrion-caspase Cascade Mechanism.
supplements.summary: Combining enzalutamide with honokiol kills drug-resistant glioblastoma cells by triggering programmed cell death through mitochondrial pathways.

supplements.title: Y-box Binding Protein 1 as a Target Molecule of a Novel Coumarin-based Anti-metastatic Agent.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified Y-box binding protein 1 as the target of a new coumarin compound that stops osteosarcoma cancer spread.

off_label.title: Combinatorial drug repurposing of Valproic acid and Zebularine regulates Krüppel-like factor 4 and β-catenin expression in colon cancer cells.

off_label.title: Unveiling Remyelinating Properties of Roflumilast in CPZ-Induced Neuronal Demyelination in Mice.

off_label.title: Bevacizumab for Radiation-Induced (Radiculo)plexopathy.
off_label.summary: Bevacizumab shows promise as the first potential treatment for nerve damage that develops years after cancer radiation therapy.

off_label.title: Multi-omics reveals a novel Cxcr4+ subpopulation of alveolar macrophages and therapeutic effect of AMD3100 in mice with advanced silicosis.

off_label.title: Potential Benefit of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2-Inhibitors in Cisplatin-Associated Nephrotoxicity Among Patients With Cancer Having Diabetes Mellitus.

off_label.summary: Liraglutide, a diabetes drug, kills breast and prostate cancer cells by increasing oxidative stress and triggering cell death pathways.

off_label.title: Real-world Clinical Outcomes of Ivermectin and Mebendazole in Cancer Patients: Results from a Prospective Observational Cohort.
off_label.summary: Antiparasitic drugs ivermectin and mebendazole show promise as accessible, low-toxicity cancer treatments in real-world patient use.

off_label.title: Looming Concerns With Gabapentin Oversight: Balancing Safety and Access.
off_label.summary: Gabapentin regulation as a controlled substance may improve safety but risks limiting access for vulnerable patients needing pain relief.

off_label.title: Drug repositioning in metastatic prostate cancer based on protein- protein interaction network: Computational and in vitro analysis.
off_label.summary: Artesunate, an existing drug, significantly reduced prostate cancer cell migration by 50% in laboratory tests, showing promise against metastasis.

off_label.summary: A combination of two drugs improved survival and heart function in rats with cancer-related body wasting.

off_label.title: The Antipsychotic Aripiprazole Induces Cytotoxicity in Bladder Cancer Cells While Preserving Urothelial and Bladder Function.
off_label.summary: Aripiprazole, an antipsychotic drug, kills bladder cancer cells while preserving normal bladder structure and function in laboratory and animal tests.

off_label.title: Metformin as a Multifaceted Therapeutic Agent for Gastrointestinal Diseases: Mechanisms, Clinical Efficacy, and Future Directions.
off_label.summary: Metformin shows promise for treating multiple gastrointestinal diseases, including colorectal cancer and hepatocellular carcinoma, through anti-inflammatory and growth-inhibiting mechanisms.

off_label.title: Low-dose dihydroartemisinin resensitizes lung cancer cells to cisplatin by suppressing interleukin-6 release by macrophages.

biomarkers.title: Human germline biallelic loss-of-function OSMR variants cause severe allergic disease.

biomarkers.summary: Sotorasib's standard lung cancer dose may be unnecessarily high; lower doses show similar benefits with fewer side effects.
